searchText: > Yes, this has happened before in test setups as well Do you have a link with more details on what happened exactly? How fast finalization was recovered and so on? Nope, it was just some message here in Discord a long time ago. Not easy to find unfortunately If anyone else has data concerning a test of a fork during an inactivity leak, I'm interested You can test this simply by having a single devnet and keys distributed among two separate and not connected beacons, you can start forked since genesis Yes I have simulated the time it would take in different settings, but I was looking for confirmation of my data
